name: The ammit
description: A lion-bodied, alligator-headed demon near impossible to kill, which kills several initiates.

timeline.summary: An ammit attacks the crop in the second chamber and kills an initiate.
timeline.quote: with one powerful bite, the ammit had caught an initiate in its jaws.

timeline.summary: Gideon charges the ammit and finds his sural cannot cut it; his golden shield holds but cannot free him from its grip.
timeline.quote: Golden ripples of light danced across my body as I focused my magic

timeline.summary: Hepthys drives the ammit off Gideon with wind magic and is caught in the air and devoured.
timeline.quote: swallowing its prize in two snapping bites.

timeline.summary: The ammit chases the last runners into the corridor and a blade kills Setha.
timeline.quote: a rogue blade reduced Setha to a black and red smear of viscera.

relations.note: leapt and clamped onto his wing before swallowing him
relations.quote: I turned to see the ammit falling from an impossible height
